Wonderful Experience at Hotel Broadway, Asaf Ali Road
We had a very comfortable and pleasant stay at Hotel Broadway, Asaf Ali Road, New Delhi. The rooms were neat, clean, and well maintained. The location is excellent and very convenient for city travel.
Special thanks to Mr. Nishant for his outstanding support and hospitality. He was extremely cooperative, polite, and always ready to assist us with a smile. His prompt service and personal attention made our stay smooth and hassle-free.
Highly recommended for both business and leisure travelers.
Thank you once again to the entire team!
— Ajay Sisodiya
